description:
Email a booking enquiry or question to the hosts on behalf of a guest.

    Use it when the guest has a question, or wants the hosts to confirm something
    before booking. To book straight away, give the guest book_url from
    get_availability or get_pricing instead. Ask the guest before sending: it
    emails their name and email address to hello@weewilds.com, and the hosts
    reply to that address.

    Does NOT create a booking. No token is needed. Limited to 3 enquiries an hour
    and 6 a day per caller; the same enquiry is only sent once a day.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
        check_in: Arrival date YYYY-MM-DD.
        check_out: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD, must be after check_in.
        guest_name: Guest's full name.
        guest_email: Valid email — the host replies here.
        guests: Number of guests (1–8).
        notes: Optional special requests or questions.

check_in.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be in the past.
check_in.title: Check In

check_out.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after check_in.
check_out.title: Check Out

guest_email.description: Guest's email address. The host replies here to confirm and arrange payment.
guest_email.title: Guest Email

guests.description: Number of guests, 1 to 8 (each unit sleeps 2).
guests.title: Guests

notes.description: Optional special requests or questions, e.g. dietary needs or arrival time. Up to 1000 characters.
notes.title: Notes

unit.description: Which WEE WiLDS unit: "muckle-meadow-pod" (Muckle Meadow Glamping Pod), "cosie-coorie-pod" (Cosy Coorie Pod) or "bb" (the B&B, all 4 rooms).
unit.title: Unit

name: send_inquiry

book_direct_url.description: Where the guest can book directly when no email was sent: the booking page with the stay's dates selected.

message.description: Confirmation to pass on to the guest.

rate_limit_remaining_this_hour.description: Enquiries this caller can still send this hour.

sent.description: true if the enquiry email was sent to the host.

title: Send booking enquiry
